title: Strict chain square computing the unrestricted relative comparison
statement: Assume derived categories of module sheaves on all schemes [def-pc-derived-category]. Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S and g′:X′→X form a cartesian square. Let K∈D(O_X), K′∈D(O_X′), φ:Lg′*K→K′ [def-pc-derived-pullback], and U,V opens of X with U∪V=X. Put a=relativeMVGlobalArrow and b(W)=relativeMVLocalArrow using the pinned maps [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. There are O_S′-module cochain complexes A,B,A′,B′ and chain maps t:A→B, t′:A′→B′, α:A→A′, β:B→B′ with tβ=αt′. Six isomorphisms identify Q(A),Q(B),Q(Cone(t)) and Q(A′),Q(B′),Q(Cone(t′)) with a.left, b(U).left⊕b(V).left, b(U∩V).left and the corresponding right vertices. Under these isomorphisms Q(α) is a.hom, Q(β) is the biproduct of b(U).hom and b(V).hom, and Q(Cone.map(t,t′,α,β)) is b(U∩V).hom. No short exact replacement is asserted and no additional geometric hypotheses are assumed.

proof.text: Apply the resolved direct-image comparison before tensor pullback to obtain a specified homotopy square on S with target complexes on S-prime. Its three derived mates already agree with the pinned relative global, middle and overlap arrows.

Transpose this specified homotopy cone-square through derived pullback. Compose its three source comparison isomorphisms d1,d2,d3 with the three geometric vertex comparisons. This gives a square on S-prime with the original three localized comparison maps.

Apply homotopy_square_cone_rectification to this square. It replaces only the source middle complex and cone. Compose its middle and cone isomorphisms with d2/e2 and d3/e3. Rewrite the three map equations by the transposition and rectification identities, then by the geometric mate equations and associativity. All target models are retained and the final square is strict.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeMV_cover_chain_square
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) :
    let a := relativeMVGlobalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    let b := relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    ∃ (A B A' B' : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
      (t : A ⟶ B) (t' : A' ⟶ B') (α : A ⟶ A') (β : B ⟶ B')
      (hc : t ≫ β = α ≫ t')
      (e₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj A ≅ a.left)
      (e₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj B ≅ (b U).left ⊞ (b V).left)
      (e₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t) ≅
        (b (U ⊓ V)).left)
      (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj A' ≅ a.right)
      (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj B' ≅ (b U).right ⊞ (b V).right)
      (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t') ≅
        (b (U ⊓ V)).right),
      DerivedCategory.Q.map α ≫ e₁'.hom = e₁.hom ≫ a.hom ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map β ≫ e₂'.hom =
        e₂.hom ≫ biprod.map (b U).hom (b V).hom ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.map t t' α β hc) ≫ e₃'.hom =
        e₃.hom ≫ (b (U ⊓ V)).hom
